design_philosophy: Modern Minimalist Arcade Football. A collision of raw athletic performance (Elite Athleticism archetype) and high-contrast brutalism. The design prioritizes visual tension, legibility, and fast-paced interaction over generic soft-UI. No AI-slop purple gradients. We rely on Deep Obsidian, stark whites, and hyper-vibrant neon accents.

rules: Headings and Scores MUST use tight letter spacing (tracking-tighter) for impact.
Never use Inter or standard sans for Headings.
Ensure body text has generous line height (leading-relaxed) in menus.
Use text-shadow on HUD elements to ensure contrast over the canvas.

colors.archetype: THE PERFORMANCE PRO mixed with NEON ACCENTS
rules: Tinted Grey Rule: All darks (like #0A0D0B) are tinted with a slight forest green to match the turf theme.
Use Pure White (#FFFFFF) for data clarity and Electric Neon Green (#00FF66) as the kinetic trigger.
Canvas should use deep muted greens; UI should be stark black/white/neon.

visual_enhancers.buttons: Neo-brutalist blocks. 0px border-radius (sharp corners). 1px solid vibrant border (#00FF66). Default transparent background, hover state fills with the vibrant color and text flips to black.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: For HUD and menus overlapping canvas: Use Crystal variant. bg-black/70 with backdrop-blur-md, and a sharp 1px border-white/10. NEVER use pure transparent backgrounds for text layers.
visual_enhancers.borders: Expose the skeleton. Use thin 1px lines (border-white/10) to separate layout zones in menus.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Hard shadows instead of soft blurs. shadow-[4px_4px_0px_#00FF66]

layouts.main_menu: Centered brutalist layout. Massive title text spanning the width. Generous spacing (gap-12). Actions stacked vertically. Background could be an abstract dark stadium image with a heavy black/70 overlay.
layouts.game_hud: Absolute positioned over canvas (z-50). Top-center bento-style scoreboard: left team score, center timer, right team score. Player labels absolute positioned left/right edge.
layouts.match_end_screen: Full screen overlay (bg-black/90 backdrop-blur-lg). Massive 'MATCH OVER' heading, winner announcement, and prominent 'PLAY AGAIN' neon button.
layouts.mobile_controls: Semi-transparent solid blocks. Bottom-left: Left/Right movement arrows. Bottom-right: Jump and Kick action buttons. Must use bg-black/50 backdrop-blur-sm border border-white/20 for visibility without totally blocking gameplay.

components.button: className="px-8 py-4 bg-transparent border border-[#00FF66] text-[#00FF66] hover:bg-[#00FF66] hover:text-black transition-colors duration-200 uppercase tracking-widest font-heading"
components.score_badge: className="px-6 py-3 bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-md border border-white/20 text-white font-heading text-5xl flex items-center justify-center min-w-[80px]"
components.timer_badge: className="px-4 py-2 bg-[#0A0D0B]/90 border border-white/10 text-white font-body text-2xl tracking-widest"
components.mobile_dpad_button: className="w-16 h-16 bg-black/50 backdrop-blur-md border border-white/20 text-white flex items-center justify-center active:bg-white/20 transition-colors"

motion.menu_transitions: Framer Motion. Fast, decisive slides and scales. duration: 0.2, ease: 'easeOut'.
motion.score_update: Quick scale bump (1.0 to 1.5 back to 1.0) when a goal is scored. Text color flashes #00FF66.
motion.hover_states: Instant color snaps. No muddy fading transitions for buttons.

images.description: A soccer field at night with the lights on. Use as the background for the Main Menu with a dark overlay to create atmosphere.
Action-packed night soccer match with players competing under field lights. Can be used as abstract texture for Match End Screen.

media.canvas_assets: For the HTML5 Canvas, draw players as stylized, clean geometric shapes (e.g., pill shapes or distinct colorful blocks). No detailed sprites needed, keep it modern and abstract.

accessibility.contrast: Text over canvas MUST have a text-shadow or be encased in a semi-transparent HUD box to guarantee contrast against moving players.
accessibility.keyboard: WASD / Arrow Keys must be fully mapped and accessible. Enter key to trigger main actions (Play, Rematch).
accessibility.reduced_motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion for score bumps and menu slides.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You are building a .js React application, NOT .tsx. Provide pure JavaScript solutions.
HTML5 Canvas must be responsive. Use standard ResizeObserver or window event listeners to scale the canvas drawing context appropriately.
DO NOT apply global transitions like 'transition: all' in CSS. Target specific properties (e.g., transition-colors).
DO NOT center align the entire app container blindly; structure layouts explicitly with flex or grid.

ALL interactive elements (buttons, mobile controls, settings toggles) MUST have a 'data-testid' attribute in kebab-case based on role (e.g., 'data-testid="play-button"', 'data-testid="mobile-btn-jump"').
Use Phosphor Icons or Lucide-React for standard UI icons (settings, sound toggle).
For sound effects, use the Web Audio API or a lightweight audio manager to play programmatic synth beeps (kick, jump, whistle, goal siren) to match the arcade aesthetic.
